data.one_liner: Integrates Help Scout Beacon SDK for customer support and communication
data.what_it_does: Streamlines customer communications in your app by wrapping the native Help Scout Beacon SDK for iOS and Android, and the Help Scout JS Beacon for web. It allows developers to launch the support UI, identify users, navigate to specific help routes, and prefill contact forms.
use_when: You use Help Scout as your customer support helpdesk platform
You need to embed an in-app customer support beacon UI on iOS, Android, and Web
avoid_when: You use a different customer support or helpdesk backend provider
You want to build a completely custom helpdesk UI from scratch using raw APIs
strengths: Handles automatic web JS beacon loader injection
Provides prefill capabilities for contact forms with attachments
weaknesses: Requires Xcode 26 / Swift 6.2 for iOS builds
Web attachments are ignored by the JS Beacon API
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a fallback meta-data beaconId in Android's AndroidManifest.xml for process-death restoration, and Xcode 26 for iOS builds.
